title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters (Geysers) — Specification
qco_name: Electric Water Heaters (Quality Control) Mandatory Order

clauses.title: Rated Pressure and Hydrostatic Proof Test Limits
clauses.text: Clause 7.1 (Rated Working Pressure and Proof Pressure): Water heater inner tanks are rated for working pressures of 0.6 MPa (6.0 bar) or 0.8 MPa (8.0 bar). Every tank shall withstand a factory hydraulic proof pressure test of 1.5 times the rated pressure (0.9 MPa to 1.2 MPa / 12 bar) for 5 minutes without leakage or permanent distortion.

clauses.title: Standing Loss / Daily Energy Consumption Limits
clauses.text: Clause 9.1 & Table 2 (Standing Energy Loss in kWh/24h): For a 25-litre vertical water heater operating at 65°C: BEE 5-Star max standing loss is 0.40 kWh/24h; 4-Star max is 0.45 kWh/24h; 3-Star max is 0.50 kWh/24h.
